entry.title: pip: GPUStack: SAML callback trusts an unverified SAMLResponse, allowing authentication bypass and account takeover (CRITICAL)
pip: GPUStack: Missing authorization on several cluster and resource endpoints allows cross-user access and cluster takeover (HIGH)
[要対応] pip: GPUStack: Authentication bypass via trusted loopback source (reverse-proxy TCP peer or X-GPUStack-Real-IP header) grants unauthenticated admin (CRITICAL) ⚠KEV
entry.content:
Claudeの仕分け：要対応 KEV掲載。GPUStackで送信元の判定をだまし、ログインなしで管理者になれる
→ gpustack を 2.2.0 以降に更新

gpustack < 2.2.0 → 2.2.0
